run_extract_meta_pipeline: run the metadata extraction pipeline to split TSV files into separate metadata and text outputs
launch_multiproc_processor: launch a multiprocess line processor to extract metadata and text from tab-separated input files
extract_metadata_and_text: extract metadata fields and text content from TSV lines starting at a specified column index
merge_split_results: merge parallel processing results into compressed lzma metadata and text output files
configure_line_processor_module: configure a MultiprocLineProcessorModule with ExtractMetaLineProc callback for parallel TSV processing
